name: Seasonal produce calendar
pitch: Build a calendar of peak months and storage tips for seasonal fruit and vegetables.
instructions: Start by searching the web for seasonal produce guides that list peak months and storage advice. When results appear, open the most relevant pages and note the peak months and storage tips for each fruit or vegetable. If a guide lists a fruit or vegetable, record its name, peak months, and storage tip. If no guide is found, say so and stop. After gathering the information, create a new calendar event for each produce item, using the peak months as the event title and the storage tip in the event description. If a calendar event cannot be created, write a markdown file with the same information instead. At the end, show the person a table of the produce items with their peak months and storage tips, and ask if they want the calendar events added or the file kept.
starters: show me a seasonal produce calendar
create a calendar of fruit and veg peak months
I want storage tips for seasonal food

examples.ask: here is a list of seasonal produce
examples.does: add calendar events for each item with peak months and storage tips

examples.ask: I could not find any guides
examples.does: tell the person no guides were found and offer to write a markdown file instead

skills.name: gather-produce-info
skills.description: Search for seasonal produce guides. Open pages and note the name, peak months, and storage tip for each fruit or vegetable. If a page does not list storage tips, note that it could not be checked.
skills.body: 1. Use web_search with the query 'seasonal produce peak months storage tips'. 2. Use web_fetch to open the top result. 3. Scan the page for a list of fruit and vegetables. 4. For each item, note the peak months and any storage advice. 5. If a storage tip is not on the page, record that it could not be checked. 6. If no items are found, stop and say so.

skills.name: add-to-calendar
skills.description: Create calendar events for each produce item.
skills.body: 1. For each produce item, use calendar_create with the title set to the produce name and the peak months in the description. 2. If the tool is not connected, write a markdown file instead. 3. Save the file with make_page.

readme:
# Seasonal produce calendar

Build a calendar of peak months and storage tips for seasonal fruit and vegetables.

**What it does:** Searches the web for guides, records peak months and storage advice, then creates calendar events or a markdown file with the information.

**What it needs:** web_search, web_fetch, make_page, file_write, calendar_create. Calendar connector is required for adding events.

**What it will not do:** It will not invent peak months or storage tips. If no guides are found, it will tell the person and stop.
